request.input:
1girl, solo, adult woman, upper body, leaning on counter, head resting sideways on her folded forearm, looking at viewer, half-closed eyes, faint smile, relaxed melancholy.

Intimate eye-level close-up along a wooden bar counter. Her face and black-clad shoulder fill the right half; her cheek nearly touches the counter, one relaxed hand beneath her lips. A sharp crystal tumbler of amber whisky and ice stands immediately left of her face. A second large glass is cropped and heavily out of focus in the lower-left foreground. Rain-streaked window fills the left background; blurred illuminated bottle shelves on the right.

Rainy night bar, amber and dark brown palette, warm golden backlight outlining silver hair, dim softly illuminated face, luminous refracted ice, wet glass droplets, glossy wooden counter reflecting the amber glass, shallow depth of field, cinematic bokeh, highly detailed.

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
